macros.name: dance
macros.doc: Mark musical cues with the \music{Title} command, dance numbers with the equivalent \dance{Title} command, and lyrics with the \lyrics{Character Name}{Lyrics} command.

macros.name: listofdances
macros.doc: You can include table-of-contents-like lists of all the musical cues and dance numbers in your script with \listofsongs and \listofdances.

macros.name: listofsongs

macros.name: lyrics

macros.name: music
macros.doc: Mark musical cues with the \music{Title} command, dance numbers with the equivalent \dance{Title} command, and lyrics with the \lyrics{Character Name}{Lyrics} command.

macros.name: rehearsalmark
macros.doc: you can connect specific spots in the script to specific spots in the score by referencing the score’s rehearsal marks with the \rehearsalmark{mark} command.

macros.name: scripttitles
macros.doc: The formatting of the act and scene heads is set by invoking \scripttitles, in order to include the act and scene counters.

macros.name: stdir
macros.doc: Stage directions are created with the \stdir command.

macros.name: transition
macros.doc: You can denote a transition (lighting cue, shift in focus, or such) with the \transition command.
